items.text: YOU HAVE ENTERED THE MONSTER-CRAWLING SLUMS OF PHLAN.  SMALL, UGLY THINGS SCURRY FROM BENEATH YOUR FEET.  IN THE DISTANCE, AN ALARM SOUNDS.

items.text: SEVERAL ORCS ARE ARGUING OVER SOME PAPERS.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A HEALTHY-LOOKING GOBLIN IS INSTRUCTING A GROUP OF YOUNG WARRIORS.  HE SMILES AND SAYS, 'I SEE OUR OPPONENTS HAVE ARRIVED.'

items.text: YOU BURST INTO AN ELEGANTLY PANELLED ROOM. A SMALL MAN SITS HUNCHED OVER A TABLE BY THE EAST WALL. HE SETS DOWN HIS PEN AND GAZES STERNLY AT YOU.  'WELL?', HE DEMANDS.

items.text: YOU GO BACK OUT THE DOOR.

items.text: 'YOU PRESUME TOO MUCH,' THE MAN SAYS QUIETLY.  HE GESTURES.

items.text: 'I HAVE NO TIME FOR THE LIKES OF YOU,' THE MAN SAYS AIRILY.  'BEGONE!'

items.text: 'I MAY HAVE A USE FOR YOU,' THE MAN SAYS. 'SOME TIME AGO, I ORDERED A SPECIAL POTION.  THE POTION IS READY BUT I CAN'T LEAVE TO FETCH IT.  BRING IT HERE, I PAY WELL.'
items.direction: perform Ohlo consistently: controlled, superior, and calculating; keep narrator identity for attribution

items.text: 'IT WAITS IN A BOOTH IN THE OLD ROPE GUILD BUT A SHORT DISTANCE TO THE SOUTHEAST FROM WHERE YOU NOW STAND.  SPEAK MY NAME, OHLO.'
items.direction: perform Ohlo consistently: controlled, superior, and calculating; keep narrator identity for attribution

items.text: 'YOU HAVE DONE WELL. GIVE ME THE POTION AND YOU WILL BE REWARDED.'
items.direction: perform Ohlo consistently: controlled, superior, and calculating; keep narrator identity for attribution

items.text: 'YOU HAVE RETURNED EMPTY HANDED,' HE OBSERVES. 'I HAVE NO TIME FOR YOU NOW.'  HE WAVES HIS HAND.

items.text: THE MAN TAKES THE POTION AND GULPS IT GREEDILY.  AS YOU WATCH, HE SEEMS TO GROW YOUNGER AND STRONGER. 'EXCELLENT,' HE SMACKS, 'YOUR REWARD.'
items.direction: perform Ohlo consistently: controlled, superior, and calculating; keep narrator identity for attribution

items.text: THE ROOM IS DIRTY AND HAS A STRONG AND UNPLEASANT ODOR.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU HAVE ENTERED A VERY UNCLEAN STABLE.  THERE IS EVIDENCE THAT A LARGE AND UNTIDY ANIMAL HAD LIVED HERE.

items.text: YOU FIND A LONG LEATHER BAG.  WILL YOU OPEN IT?

items.text: YOU INTERRUPT SOME FEEDING KOBOLDS.

items.text: YOU WANDER IN THE OLD HEMP MARKET.  MONSTERS SCURRY AT YOUR APPROACH.  YOU OCCASSIONALLY CATCH SNATCHES OF CONVERSATIONS.

items.text: ... THE GANG IS OPERATING FROM THE CATACOMBS BY THE WELL...
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: ... THE TEMPLE OVER THE RIVER IS RUN BY SOME HOT-SHOT ORC...

items.text: ... THERE IS A SECRET TREASURE ROOM IN THE NW CORNER ...

items.text: SEATED AT A TABLE IS A RAGGED OLD WOMAN. SHE GREETS YOU. 'WELCOME. FOR THE PRICE OF A FEW COPPERS, I WILL TELL YOUR FORTUNE.'

items.text: BLOOD AND VIOLENCE ARE WRIT BOLDLY IN YOUR FUTURE.  LOOK FOR FRIENDS WHERE YOU EXPECT ENEMIES AND ENEMIES WHERE YOU EXPECT ALLIES.

items.text: A POWERFUL ONE BECOMES AWARE OF YOUR DEEDS AND SEEKS TO DESTROY YOU.  A WEAK ONE SEES YOU AS A PATH TO POWER.

items.text: THE TIME IS NIGH WHEN THE PATHS YOU HAVE TROD WILL EMPTY AND YOU MUST SEEK NEW WAYS.  THE RIDDLE'S ANSWER IS GREAT EVIL USING GREAT GOOD FOR GREAT EVIL.

items.text: SOME MONSTERS ARE TOSSING A SACK OF GRAIN. WHEN THE SACK BREAKS THEY WAIL, 'OH, NO! WHAT CAN WE THROW NOW?' ONE LOOKS YOUR WAY. 'I KNOW,' HE SAYS.
